Trusted local cleaners, eco-friendly products, and a finish you'll actually notice.

checklist.heading: General Cleaning Checklist — Manchester
checklist.intro: Our standard general clean covers all key areas of your home. Here is exactly what is included on every visit:

tasks: Wipe down all worktops, splashbacks, and surfaces
Clean exterior of oven, microwave, and fridge
Degrease hob and extractor filter
Sink and tap scrub and polish
Wipe cabinet fronts and handles
Sweep and mop hard floors
Empty and reline bins
Scrub and disinfect toilet bowl, seat, and cistern
Clean and descale shower, bath, and taps
Wipe tiles, mirrors, and glass surfaces
Clean sink and vanity unit
Mop floor and wipe skirting boards
Restock toilet paper and fold towels if provided
Dust all surfaces, shelves, and furniture
Vacuum upholstered furniture and cushions
Vacuum and mop all floors
Clean mirrors and glass surfaces
Empty bins and replace liners
Tidy and straighten cushions and throws
Wipe light switches, door handles, and skirting boards
Vacuum stairs and landing
Dust banisters and handrails
Wipe down door frames and skirting boards
Mop hard hallway floors

whyMatters.heading: Why Regular Professional Cleaning Makes a Difference
body: A consistent cleaning routine does more than keep your home looking good — it reduces allergens, bacteria, and dust build-up that can affect your family's health over time. Professional cleaners are trained to reach the spots that get missed in a quick home tidy: behind appliances, inside cupboard hinges, along skirting boards, and in bathroom grout lines.

Many of our customers find that booking a regular fortnightly clean removes the mental load of keeping on top of housework — freeing up time for the things that matter. Whether you work long hours, have young children, or simply want your home maintained to a high standard, a regular Cleaniq Services general clean is the simplest way to stay on top of it.

Our eco-friendly cleaning products mean no harsh chemical smells left in your home and no risk to children or pets. We bring everything we need, show up on time, and leave your home genuinely clean — not just surface-wiped.

compare.label: General or Deep Clean?
compare.h2: General clean or deep clean: what's the difference?
compare.intro: Both leave your home clean, but they're designed for different jobs. Here's how to choose:

cards.title: General clean
cards.body: A thorough clean of every room's everyday areas: worktops and the outside of appliances, bathrooms, dusting, vacuuming, mopping and bins. Ideal as a one-off refresh or as a regular weekly or fortnightly clean.

cards.title: Deep clean
cards.body: A top-to-bottom clean that goes further, reaching inside appliances and cupboards, behind furniture and built-up limescale and grime. Best for homes that haven't had a proper clean for a while. Read more about our [deep cleaning in Manchester](/service/deep-cleaning-manchester).

experts.label: Home Cleaners Manchester
experts.h2: Professional home cleaners in Manchester you can trust
paras: Every Cleaniq Services cleaner has a face-to-face interview, background checks and a practical skills assessment before they clean a customer's home. They know what a proper general clean should cover and work through every room methodically, so nothing is missed.

Your cleaner works carefully around your belongings, follows the notes you leave and lets us know if they spot anything that needs your attention. If anything isn't right after your clean, tell us within 48 hours and we'll send a cleaner back to put it right, free of charge.
points: Interviewed face to face and background checked.

Trained to follow our general cleaning checklist.

tips.label: Tips
tips.h2: How to get the most from your general clean
tips.intro: A little preparation helps your cleaner make the most of the time you've booked, so more of your home gets cleaned:
tips: Clear away clutter, clothes and toys so your cleaner can reach surfaces and floors.
Tell us which rooms matter most, so your cleaner can start there.
Book enough hours for the size of your home, especially for a first clean.
Let us know about pets and how your cleaner can get in if you won't be home.
Leave out any cleaning products you'd like us to use, or choose our eco-friendly supplies when you book.

Tell us within 48 hours if anything wasn't right, so we can put it right quickly.

faqs.q: What is included in a general cleaning service?
faqs.a: Our general clean covers all main living areas: kitchen surfaces and appliances, bathrooms and toilets, bedroom and living room dusting and vacuuming, hard floor mopping, and bin emptying. You can also request specific extras when booking.

faqs.q: How often should I book a general clean?
faqs.a: Most customers book fortnightly, which keeps the home in great condition between cleans. Weekly cleans are popular for larger families or busy households. One-off cleans are also available for any occasion.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home during the clean?
faqs.a: No — many of our regular customers provide a key or entry code and go about their day. All our cleaners are vetted, insured, and trusted to work independently in your home.

faqs.q: Do you bring your own cleaning products and equipment?
faqs.a: You choose: use your own supplies, or we bring eco-friendly cleaning products and equipment for £10 per visit. Just let us know when booking.

faqs.q: What Manchester areas do you cover for general cleaning?
faqs.a: We cover all of Greater Manchester including City Centre, Salford, Didsbury, Chorlton, Stockport, Trafford, Wythenshawe, Ancoats, and surrounding postcodes.

faqs.q: Can I book a one-off general clean?
faqs.a: Yes. Book a single general clean whenever you need one, or set up weekly or fortnightly visits if you'd like regular cleaning.

faqs.q: How much does general cleaning cost in Manchester?
faqs.a: General cleaning is charged by the hour. You choose how many hours you need when you book, and the current rate comes straight from our booking system.

faqs.q: How long does a general clean take?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of your home and how much needs doing. You choose the number of hours when you book. If you're not sure, call us on 07846 726428 and we'll help you decide.

faqs.q: What's the difference between a general clean and a deep clean?
faqs.a: A general clean covers the everyday areas of every room. A deep clean goes further, reaching inside appliances and cupboards, behind furniture and built-up limescale and grime.

faqs.q: Can I add oven or carpet cleaning to a general clean?
faqs.a: Yes. Add oven cleaning or carpet cleaning when you book, or book them separately.

faqs.q: What if I'm not happy with my clean?
faqs.a: Tell us within 48 hours and we'll send a cleaner back to put it right, free of charge.
